name: Silicon photodiode-trap responsivity transfer using NIST LOCR at approximately5.4 K
plain_name: Calibrate an optical detector by electrical-substitution radiometry
description: Calibrate an optical detector by electrical-substitution radiometry. A bounded, source-grounded procedure profile; compatibility covers the listed checks and does not guarantee measured scientific performance.

sources.citation: Houston and Livigni (2001), Comparison of Two Cryogenic Radiometers at NIST, J. Res. NIST 106, 641-647

requirements.rationale: Replicate the paper's approximate absorbing-cavity operating condition; this point is not a required tolerance. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.

A calibrated heater, absorber and constant-temperature substitution readout are essential. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.
The calibrated laser must reach the receiving cavity and transfer detector. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.

missing_information: Laser wavelength, beam power, underfilling aperture, window transmission and electrical/optical nonequivalence require separate review; the published uncertainty and responsivity are not predicted by this verdict.
confirmation_note: Profile author reviewed these exact sourced conditions on 2026-10-31. The application must still require the user's review/confirmation; all edits invalidate confirmation.
